_doc: VTID-05236. Commits that landed on main without a VTID in their subject and cannot get a change suite after the fact. Each entry names the FULL sha, the VTID whose staging-tests.json covers it, why, and who approved it. STAGING-VERIFY runs the covering suite and lists the commit as covered. Only commits with no VTID of their own are affected.
